items.title: Walmart Stocks Fall 1.04% Despite Raised Outlook and 23% U.S. E-Commerce Jump
items.summary: A $188.8 billion quarter and a higher EPS range met more than $2 billion of extra costs and a rich valuation.

items.title: ExxonMobil Secures Government Approval for Revised Rovuma LNG Plan
items.summary: XOM secures Mozambique's approval for a revised Rovuma LNG plan, lifting capacity to 18.6 MTPA while targeting lower costs and emissions.
